text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozabican press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Officials in the attorney-general's office want to question three members of parliament in connection with alleged crimes. The three include Aly Dauto, of the majority Frelimo Party, a former justice minister who heads parliament's legal affairs committee. The others are members of the Renamo opposition party.
- The 1997 cereal production in Mozambique is estimated at more than 1.5 million tonnes, including 1.043 tonnes of maize, the major staple.
